purpose: Focused retrospective pre-playoff production comparison and earlier-seasons-only calibration. No promotion, no production changes.
cases: Identical 2013-2026 pre-playoff snapshots: 1211 games and 210 series. Validate event identities, cutoffs, outcomes and projected series home court before reusing cached walk-forward forecasts.
calibration: p_calibrated = expit(a * logit(p_raw)); one positive slope, no intercept, independently fitted for each model and target (games/series). Preserve matchup-complement symmetry.
fit: Bounded maximum likelihood, a in [0.25,4], no tuning. Expanding window of only earlier complete-season out-of-season PRE-PLAYOFF forecasts; never in-sample predictions or October/January duplicates. Check all calibration outcomes resolved before target cutoff.
warmup: Require at least three earlier scored seasons; use identity slope 1 for 2013-2015. Active fitted calibration begins in 2016. Report this explicitly.
comparison: Raw and calibrated versions of ALL THREE models, paired whole-season 2000-resample intervals, separate per-season differences and 10-bin ECE.
limits: These historical outcomes have already been examined; results are diagnostic, not a new promotion holdout.
Pre-playoff production inputs use completed regular-season features and actual live blending, not an archived vendor-vintage table.
Calibration is a post-hoc output diagnostic, separately for game/series targets; it is not yet a coherent calibrated season-simulation implementation.
Original uncertainty and player promotion rules stay unchanged; displayed odds stay unchanged.
